fields.name: order
fields.description: Sort order of results by timestamp. Use `asc` for ascending order or `desc` for descending order.

fields.name: after
fields.description: Identifier for the last item from the previous pagination request

fields.name: Id
fields.description: Unique identifier for the video job.

fields.name: Object
fields.description: The object type, which is always `video`.

fields.name: Progress
fields.description: Approximate completion percentage for the generation task.

fields.name: CreatedAt
fields.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) for when the job was created.

fields.name: Seconds
fields.description: Duration of the generated clip in seconds. For extensions, this is the stitched total duration.
